overview.description: Kollur Mookambika Temple is an ancient Shakta shrine located at Kollur in Byndoor Taluk of Udupi District in Tulunadu, Karnataka. Dedicated to Mother Goddess Mookambika, the sanctum enshrines the revered Jyotirlinga integrating Adi Parashakti with Mahakali, Mahalakshmi, and Mahasaraswathi. Nestled along the Souparnika River at the foothills of Kodachadri, this sacred pilgrimage is revered as one of the 108 Durgalayas and 108 Shivalayas.
